name: Kujira no Hone
source:
This is a combination of visual novel & jigsaw puzzle with 170+ still images!

Nonhuman x nonhuman boys love with the theme of sexual violation, set in an alternate world.

No bad endings. Only good endings for each.

[Edited from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE230781.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
这是视觉小说和拼图游戏的结合，有170多张静态图像！

非人类x非人类男孩喜欢以性侵犯为主题，背景设定在另一个世界。

没有不好的结局。只有每个人都有好的结局。

[编辑自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE230781.html]DLsite English[/url]]
